title: Administrator - Financial Services
description:
We are working with a highly successful and rapidly growing financial services business to recruit an additional Financial Services Administrator to join their Bristol team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced administrator with a background in financial services, particularly those with experience across pensions, investments, platforms, providers or financial products, who are looking to develop their career within a successful and expanding organisation.

The business has experienced significant growth in recent years and has ambitious plans for further expansion. Despite its growing national presence, it maintains a strong focus on local teams, collaboration and delivering an excellent experience for clients.

The Role

The successful candidate will join a small, supportive administration team and work closely with Advisers, Paraplanners and colleagues across the wider business.

The role will provide broad exposure to financial services administration, supporting the processing of client business and ongoing servicing requirements. Responsibilities will include:
- Processing financial services administration across pensions, investments and other financial products
- Using provider and platform systems to process transactions and client instructions
- Processing new business and top-up applications
- Processing fund switches, purchases, sales and income withdrawal requests
- Processing Letters of Authority and obtaining information from providers
- Supporting advisers with client meeting preparation and collating relevant information
- Preparing client reports, review packs and supporting documentation
- Maintaining accurate client records and updating internal systems
- Supporting ongoing client servicing and administration
- Assisting with wider administrative projects and supporting colleagues during busy periods

About You

This role is particularly suited to someone with previous financial services administration experience, rather than requiring a specific background within IFA or financial planning.

Relevant experience could include working within pensions, investments, wealth management, platforms, insurance, banking or other areas of financial services.

Strong administrative skills, excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage and prioritise your workload are essential. You will also need to be confident communicating with clients, providers and colleagues and be comfortable learning new systems and processes.

Package
- Salary up to £35,000
- Hybrid working - minimum 2 day a week in the office
- Strong holiday entitlement + birthday off
- Opportunity to purchase additional annual leave
- Good pension contributions
- Private medical insurance
- Life assurance x 4
- Income protection
- Full support with professional exams and relevant training
- A number of additional company benefits

The Opportunity

This is a great opportunity for a Financial Services Administrator looking to join a growing organisation where they can build on their existing industry experience, develop new skills and establish a long-term career.

The role offers the opportunity to gain wider exposure across financial services while working within a supportive team and benefiting from the resources, career opportunities and stability of a growing national business.

title: Claims Administrator
description:
Claims Administrator - Life & Pensions Operations

Locations:

Bristol Hybrid

Business: SS&C Financial Services International Limited

Role Type: Permanent

Get To Know Us:

SS&C is seeking a Claims Administrator to join our Life & Pensions Operations team in Bristol. The role will be responsible for the accurate and timely administration of claims across a range of life, protection and pension products within a regulated outsourced environment.

Working as part of a client-focused operational team, the successful candidate will manage claims through the end-to-end lifecycle, ensuring customers and beneficiaries receive an efficient, accurate and empathetic service. The role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgement and the ability to work within defined regulatory, contractual and operational controls.

SS&C is leading the way. We continue to look for todays and tomorrow's brightest talent, those that embody a spirit to improve not only their lives, but those around them. From college students to seasoned and experienced professionals, we encourage you to apply. SS&C prides itself on hiring diverse, honest, dynamic individuals, who value collaboration, accountability, and innovation to name a few.

Why You Will Love It Here!
- Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model
- Your Future: Professional Development Reimbursement including access to SS&C University
- Work/Life Balance: Competitive holiday scheme
- Your Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
- Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
- Training: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career

What You Will Get To Do:
- Manage life, protection and pension claims from initial notification through to assessment, settlement and closure.
- Review claim documentation and policy information to establish eligibility and ensure all required evidence has been received.
- Liaise professionally and sensitively with customers, beneficiaries, advisers, trustees and other relevant parties throughout the claims process.
- Obtain and review supporting documentation, escalating complex or unusual cases to appropriate technical specialists where required.
- Accurately calculate and process claim benefits in accordance with policy terms, procedures and delegated authorities.
- Maintain accurate and complete customer and policy records across relevant administration and workflow systems.
- Ensure claims are progressed within agreed SLAs, quality standards and client requirements, proactively managing outstanding information and potential delays.
- Complete appropriate quality and control checks and ensure a clear audit trail is maintained for all decisions and transactions.
- Identify and escalate potential customer detriment, complaints, financial crime concerns, data protection issues or other operational risks.
- Apply appropriate consideration to vulnerable customers and Consumer Duty requirements, supporting the delivery of good customer outcomes.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Actuarial, Client Services and other specialist teams to resolve complex cases.
- Support reconciliation, reporting and MI requirements associated with claims processing.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen controls and improve customer experience.
- Support cross-training and knowledge sharing to build capability and resilience across the wider Operations team.

What You Will Bring:

Essential
- Strong administration experience with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage multiple cases and priorities within a deadline-driven operational environment.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate sensitively and professionally with customers and other stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify when issues require escalation.
- Comfortable working within defined procedures, controls and regulatory requirements.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills.
- Ability to work collaboratively as part of a wider operational team.

Desirable
- Previous experience in Life & Pensions, insurance, protection, investments or wider financial services.
- Previous claims administration or claims-handling experience would be particularly advantageous.
- Knowledge of life assurance, pensions or protection products.
- Experience working within an FCA-regulated environment or outsourced/BPO operation.
- Understanding of Consumer Duty, vulnerable customer requirements and the importance of good customer outcomes.
- Experience using policy administration, workflow or case-management systems.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong operational discipline with a customer-focused mindset. Claims frequently arise at significant or difficult points in a customer's life, so accuracy, empathy and ownership are equally important.

The successful candidate will be comfortable taking responsibility for cases, following them through to resolution and escalating issues appropriately, while maintaining the high standards of quality, control and customer service expected within SS&C's Life & Pensions business.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.

title: Claims Handler
description:
Job Title: Claims Handler

Location: Bristol (Hybrid - 3 days per week in the office)

Salary: Up to £35,000

Benefits: Hybrid working, professional qualification support (CII), long-term progression opportunities

About the Company:

This is an opportunity to join a well-established and growing specialist insurer with a strong reputation across financial lines, construction, accident & health, and affinity products. Backed by a major international parent group, the business combines the stability and support of a global insurer with the close-knit culture of a smaller regional team. With excellent staff retention and ambitious growth plans over the next few years, the business offers genuine long-term career development within a collaborative environment.

Role Summary:

This is an opportunity to join a busy claims function and manage insurance claims from first notification through to settlement or resolution.

You'll take ownership of claim outcomes, work closely with customers, brokers, adjusters and suppliers, and build broader technical exposure across coverage, liability, reserving and claims decision-making.

Key Responsibilities:
- Manage claims from FNOL through to resolution: Build end-to-end claims experience while taking ownership of outcomes
- Review policy terms, coverage and claim documentation: Develop stronger technical judgement around coverage and liability decisions
- Communicate with customers and brokers: Build trusted relationships while providing clear and professional claims updates
- Liaise with TPAs, adjusters and suppliers: Gain exposure to the wider claims process and external stakeholders
- Maintain accurate, audit-ready claim files: Strengthen your understanding of regulatory, data and compliance requirements
- Monitor reserves, indemnity spend and settlement strategy: Develop commercial awareness and intelligent claims decision-making

Requirements:
- Experience or technical knowledge of insurance claims, including the claims lifecycle from FNOL through to settlement
- Understanding of policy wordings, coverage principles and liability assessment, with familiarity with Civil Procedure Rules and the litigation process
- Awareness of FCA requirements, Consumer Duty, data protection and fair customer outcomes
- Confident communication, organisation and claims-system skills, with the ability to manage workloads and escalate complex matters appropriately

If this role isn't quite right, it's still worth speaking to one of our specialist team - we may be working on something that hasn't hit the market yet.

title: Finance Billing Coordinator
description:
About the role

Are you an organised and detail-focused finance professional who enjoys solving problems and making sure things are done accurately and on time?

We're looking for a Finance Billing Coordinator to join our Finance team and play an important role in ensuring Hft's income is billed accurately, submitted on time and collected efficiently.

The role has a particular focus on Housing billing, while also providing wider support to our Management Accounting team with billing queries, income processes and month-end activities.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Finance and Operations, as well as external stakeholders including Local Authorities, funders and families. You'll need to be confident managing regular deadlines, investigating discrepancies and resolving billing issues, while maintaining excellent attention to detail.

This is a great opportunity for someone with experience in finance, billing, accounts receivable or finance administration who wants to develop their skills within a supportive and collaborative Finance team.

What you'll be doing

You'll take responsibility for a range of billing and income activities, including:
- Coordinating regular Housing billing processes and ensuring invoices are accurate, complete and issued on time.
- Preparing and processing invoices and credit notes.
- Processing changes to customer and tenancy information and billing requirements.
- Submitting invoices to Local Authorities, funders and other customers through relevant systems and portals.
- Monitoring rejected, disputed and unpaid invoices and following up to ensure issues are resolved.
- Responding to billing and income queries from Finance, Operations and external stakeholders.
- Investigating discrepancies, missing information and changes to care or housing arrangements.
- Supporting the Management Accounting team with month-end income activities, including Housing income accruals and deferrals.
- Completing relevant reconciliations and financial checks.
- Providing information and supporting documentation for financial reporting and audit.
- Maintaining accurate records and a clear audit trail.
- Identifying opportunities to improve billing processes, systems and ways of working.
- Providing wider support to the Finance team during busy periods.

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who is:
- Experienced in a finance, billing, accounts receivable or finance administration environment.
- Comfortable processing invoices, credit notes and other financial transactions.
- Confident dealing with queries and working with both internal and external stakeholders.
- Highly organised, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and standard Microsoft Office applications.
- Comfortable investigating discrepancies and taking ownership of resolving problems.
- A clear and professional communicator.
- Able to work independently while also being a collaborative member of the wider team.
- Committed to accuracy, financial controls and meeting deadlines.

Experience of working with Local Authorities, funders, Housing or care-related billing would be desirable, as would experience using finance systems, billing platforms or online portals. An AAT or relevant finance qualification would also be advantageous.

Why join Hft?

At Hft, our mission is simple: the best life possible.

We believe people with learning disabilities should be able to live within their communities, with all the choice and support they need to live the best life possible.

As part of our Finance team, you'll play an important role behind the scenes, helping ensure our services have the financial support they need to make this happen.

We're looking for someone who shares our commitment to getting things right, working collaboratively and continually looking for better ways of doing things.

Working arrangements

This is a full-time, permanent hybrid role based in Bristol.

You will be required to work from our Bristol office at least one day each week, with the remainder of your working week carried out from home.

Please ensure you are able to meet this minimum weekly office attendance requirement before applying.

Recruitment process

The closing date for applications is 30 September 2026.

Our recruitment process will consist of one interview stage, which will be held virtually via Microsoft Teams.

If you're looking for your next finance opportunity and would like to make a meaningful contribution as part of a collaborative team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Technical Claims Handler
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new firm

Our client is a highly respected UK law firm with a well-established insurance practice and a growing delegated claims handling service. Based in the firm's Bristol office, the team manages claims on an outsourced basis for a broad range of leading insurers, underwriting businesses and insurance organisations.

Operating under delegated authority, the team reviews, adjusts and settles claims from first notification through to resolution. Its work focuses on financial loss claims made against professionals, including professional indemnity, title indemnity, technology and media matters. The team does not handle consumer, retail or personal injury claims.

The wider claims function is structured across scheme managers, technical claims handlers, senior claims handlers and claims handlers. Each client is supported by a dedicated scheme manager and claims team, with individuals typically working across more than one client or scheme. This role will be based in the firm's Bristol office, with occasional travel to London where required.

Your new role

This opportunity is available on either a permanent or a 9 month fixed-term contract basis, offering flexibility depending on your preference and circumstances.

An excellent opportunity to join a specialist and growing team, managing a reduced caseload of complex professional indemnity claims while providing technical support, coaching and guidance to colleagues. You'll work closely with insurers, scheme managers and stakeholders to deliver high-quality claims handling and strategic decision-making.
Key responsibilities:
- Manage complex professional indemnity claims from notification to resolution.
- Assess policy coverage, liability, quantum and insurer exposure.
- Investigate claims, develop strategies and make decisions within delegated authority.
- Negotiate settlements and provide accurate insurer reporting.
- Manage external legal providers where required.
- Support, mentor and train claims colleagues.
- Build strong relationships with insurers, brokers, insureds and stakeholders.
- Ensure compliance with SLAs, KPIs and reserving requirements.
- Maintain accurate records on the case management system.

What you'll need to succeed

You will have strong technical claims handling experience and a sound understanding of insurance principles, policy coverage and delegated authority arrangements. Previous professional indemnity claims experience would be valuable, although the team is also open to candidates from transferable insurance backgrounds, including commercial insurance or legal expenses insurance, who demonstrate the right technical aptitude and attitude to learning.You will be confident assessing policy coverage, liability and quantum, and able to make well-reasoned decisions in the best interests of insurers. You will also understand the importance of compliance, accurate reporting, service level agreements and the consistent application of client reserving policies.As an important part of the role involves supporting others, you should enjoy coaching, mentoring and sharing technical knowledge with colleagues. You will be able to explain complex claims issues clearly and provide constructive guidance to less experienced team members.You will also possess:
- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality work.
- Commercial and practical approach to claims handling.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What you'll get in return

You will join a growing and specialist claims team, gaining exposure to complex, high-quality professional indemnity work for an impressive range of insurers and delegated authority providers.The firm is prepared to invest in training candidates with relevant transferable insurance experience. You will receive technical support from experienced claims professionals, alongside specialist training delivered by lawyers from across the wider firm, including teams with expertise in areas such as construction and professional negligence.There is a strong focus on developing and promoting people internally. As the team continues to grow, there may be opportunities to progress into senior claims handling, technical supervision or scheme management positions, subject to individual development and suitable roles becoming available.The firm offers a supportive, inclusive and collaborative working environment, together with a flexible hybrid working approach where possible. Support and reasonable adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process and during employment.

What you need to do now

If you are interested in this Technical Claims Handler opportunity or would like further information, please get in touch for a confidential discussion.If this position is not quite right but you are considering new opportunities within claims, insurance or legal services, we would still be keen to hear from you.We would expect someone with the appropriate level of technical claims experience to have developed the skills required for this position. However, applications from candidates with different levels or types of relevant insurance experience are encouraged and will be considered.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Administrative Assistant
description: The post holder will provide administration support and audio typing to the Gastroenterology and Hepatology service. Provide support to ensure efficient and effective day to day running of the service. The role requires someone who has great attention to detail and excellent organisational skills for working in a fast paced, busy department. The role will consist mainly of processing clinic and adhoc letters using multiple hospital systems. You will be required to complete letters to a high standard with accuracy as well as carrying out general clerical duties such as filing, photocopying, scanning, post and any other administrative task in line with banding. The post holder will be required to prove efficiency, whilst maintaining accuracy in detail, ensuring appropriate document layout and often proof reading content to ensure clear and professional dissemination of information. Skills Excellent communication and telephone skills, with the ability to communicate sensitively, tactfully and professionally. Maintain confidentiality and discretion at all times. Ability to work independently, use initiative and prioritise workload effectively. Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook and Excel, with excellent keyboard skills. Able to follow procedures accurately when processing correspondence and related actions. Fast and accurate typing and processing of large volumes of information. Excellent written skills, including proofreading and checking accuracy. Experience in an office environment undertaking correspondence, filing, photocopying and general clerical duties. Confident and empathetic communication with patients, GPs and healthcare professionals. Experience working effectively within a team, ensuring tasks and responsibilities are clearly understood. NHS or similar healthcare experience desirable. Computer literate with good knowledge of Word and Outlook; Excel desirable. Experience entering and retrieving information from computer systems. Knowledge of medical terminology desirable. Understanding of confidentiality and data protection requirements. Experience of audio typing/digital dictation, or willingness to undertake training. Willingness to learn and use the Trust's patient record system. Ability to support and train new team members. To accurately and efficiently type letters and documents using an audio dictation system in a timely manner. Processing of patient admin and clinic letters, reviewing, editing, completing, printing and sending a paper copy to the patient. To look up and check data on the electronic patient record system, including confirmation of the patient/GP address etc. There may be times when patient notes are not available, and more information will need to be retrieved from the IT system. To save work on the network drive in a format which is consistent with the department and can be easily located and retrieved. To raise any queries relating to specific patient letters or the overall clinic with the appropriate Medical Secretary. To ensure any actions in dictated correspondence are passed for action to the appropriate personnel. To accurately trace patient notes from one location to another on the electronic patient record system Diligent and accurate processing of patients information. To enter patient level data onto a spreadsheet in order to monitor test results. To carry out other clerical activities as required, such as photocopying, filing, sorting and distributing letters, sorting post etc. To answer queries relevant to role from administrative and clinical staff in a professional and courteous manner, referring on to a relevant staff member if necessary. To work in partnership with the Medical Secretary and wider administrative team. To provide cross-cover for colleagues during times of absence. To ensure patient confidentiality is maintained at all times. To carry out other reasonable duties, appropriate to the grade, as agreed between the post holder and Support Manager.
